summary: On May 29, 2026, TXNM Energy, Inc.'s subsidiaries filed regulatory applications: Texas-New Mexico Power Company filed a comprehensive settlement in its base rate review pending before the Public Utility Commission of Texas; Public Service Company of New Mexico filed an application with the New Mexico Public Regulatory Commission requesting approval of resources for a plan to advance carbon-free generation under state clean energy requirements. These are routine regulatory filings in the ordinary course of business for a utility, not a special situation. The 8-K furnishes press releases as exhibits. No deal terms, premiums, or transactional elements are present; this is a standard rate case and resource planning filing.
